subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column 'A', 'B' and 'C' to write five complete sentences.
stimulus: 1  5 = 5 Column 'A' Column 'B' Column 'C' (a) 26 March i. every yea in the country i. holiday in our country. (b) It is ii. begins ii. with great enthusiasm and fervour (c) The day is iii. a national iii. floral wreaths at the National (d) The day celebrated iv. our independence day Mausoleum at Savar. (e) Early in the morning v. the President and the Prime iv. with a 31 gun salute. Minister place v. is one of the most important state festivals.
guide_solution: Matching (a) 26 March our independence day is one of the most important state festivals. (b) It is a national holiday in our country. (c) The day begins with a 31 gun salute. (d) The day is celebrated every year in the country with great enthusiasm and fervour. (e) Early in the morning the President and the Prime Minister place floral wreaths at the National Mausoleum at Savar.
